### Lisa Seitz-Gruwell departs Wikimedia Foundation, Wikimedia Endowment

A woman with shoulder-length light-brown hair wearing a brown jacket and blue jeans sitting smiling on a low wall in a garden

Wikimedia's longstanding Chief Advancement Officer Lisa Seitz-Gruwell left the Wikimedia Foundation last month and has been replaced as Chief Advancement Officer and President of the Wikimedia Endowment by Sheetal Puri, who has taken on both roles in an interim capacity. [...] Wired summarized the challenges facing the Wikimedia movement: "Wikipedia needs to make a bold push to become more attractive than AI—and shaping that strategy shouldn't be left to management alone."
